AI File Renamers Compared

# Best Riffo Alternatives, Compared

Riffo (riffo.ai) is a Mac-only AI file renamer. It reads images, PDFs, and documents, then writes a descriptive filename. It's currently free. It runs on AWS, Google Cloud, and OpenAI infrastructure. It's kept shipping updates since its June 2024 launch. Two things send people looking for a Riffo alternative: the Mac-only ceiling, and pricing that's never been published anywhere. This page compares Riffo against six tools that read file content the same way, so you can find one that fits your platform and your budget.

## What Is Riffo, and Why Look for an Alternative [...] ## What Is Riffo, and Why Look for an Alternative

Riffo runs on Mac only. There's no Windows or Linux build, and none has been announced. It reads the content of images, PDFs, and general documents. Then it proposes a name based on what it finds. It also offers "Auto Foldering," a feature that sorts renamed files into folders on its own.

Pricing is the murkier part. Riffo's own pricing page shows no price at all when you visit it directly. A 2024 Reddit thread asked the same question, with no clear answer from Riffo. One third-party aggregator has floated a rough $15-a-month figure. That number isn't confirmed anywhere on Riffo's own site. Treat it as a rumor, not a fact. What you can say for certain: Riffo is free to use today, with no stated cap or expiration on that. [...] Is there a Windows version of Riffo?

No. Riffo runs on Mac only, with no announced Windows or Linux build.

What's the closest free alternative to Riffo that also runs on Windows?

Wisfile is the closest match. It's free, with no subscription, and it already runs on both Windows and Mac, unlike Riffo's Mac-only build.

Can any of these tools read presentation files or spreadsheets?

Renamer.ai is the only tool in this comparison with confirmed support for slides, spreadsheets, and email files, alongside PDFs and images. Riffo, Wisfile, FilesDesk, RenameClick, and NameQuick are all scoped to documents and images.
